verdict.rationale: Evidence shows ECC memory support and vPro details from Intel's ARK spec page, and community reports confirm a rated DDR5 speed (DDR5-6400) and CUDIMM support, but no explicit vendor-published memory capacity ceiling or bandwidth figures are quoted in the pack. The probe confirms ARK has a 'machine-fetchable spec sheet' including memory support, but the actual numbers aren't captured here. missing for 10: explicit max memory capacity (GB), number of channels, and bandwidth (GB/s) figures from vendor docs.
